title: builder boundary check is blind to committed work: changed-files diffs the worktree against its own HEAD
detail: consistency._git_worktree_changed_files returns git diff --name-only HEAD + untracked-not-ignored inside worktrees/<role>. drive tells every builder to commit on the worktree branch, after which HEAD includes the work and the diff is empty. builder_writes_within_plan and sprint_changed_files (blast-radius consumption) therefore check nothing on a drive sprint. Repro (2026-11-17): worktree on sprint/x-solo, commit outside.py, _git_worktree_changed_files -> [] for outside.py. The builder change set must be measured against the sprint base (merge-base with the integration branch) plus uncommitted + untracked-not-ignored, from one function. The conventions-enforcer spec separately lists files with 'find worktrees/ -type f', which counts gitignored caches (fb-e4f46ed05574 second half); it should read the same change set.

resolution.verify: uv run python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_review_round_integrity.py
